page.overview:
Who is Keung?

Keung enlisted as a soldier in the Fire Nation military during the late Hundred Year War and became a spy. Rising to command a unit of infiltrators, he and his comrades disguised themselves as travelers and merchants to sneak into Earth Kingdom settlements where they waged sabotage campaigns to facilitate their nation's advances. Eventually, Keung started to serve under Iroh, Crown Prince of the Fire Nation and general of the Fire Army. He soon began to deeply admire his superior, mimicking his leadership style -including a deep interest in tea- and even regarding himself as a kind of "son" to the general.

In 94 AG, Iroh started a campaign to conquer the Earth Kingdom capital of Ba Sing Se. Keung and his unit were sent in advance, covertly moving into the massive city. When Iroh's armies laid siege, Keung's troops initiated a series of attacks to weaken Ba Sing Se's defenses, taking out "key military targets". Keung believed that a Fire Nation victory was within sight. However, Iroh instead ordered a retreat. Cut off from their comrades, Keung's unit was subsequently hunted and destroyed by Ba Sing Se's defenders; only Keung himself escaped with his life. Believing that Iroh was solely responsible for his comrades' demise, the spy's long-held admiration turned into bitter hatred.

After the failed siege, Keung eventually moved to the Fire Nation colony of Daxia Harbor, a haven for criminals. There, he used his past skills to become a crime boss, founding the Wuyi Tea Cartel and gradually capturing the international tea trade. After the Hundred Year War's end, the cartel ultimately managed to gain control of most of the Earth Kingdom's tea shipping and effectively seized control of Daxia Harbor.

As his power grew, Keung eventually hired the infamous bounty hunter June to kidnap Iroh who had become the owner of the Jasmine Dragon tea shop. When the bounty hunter successfully delivered the ex-general to the cartel headquarters in Daxia Harbor, the crime boss smugly reintroduced himself. When June and Iroh expressed surprise at the situation, Keung explained his backstory and last years to the two, emphasizing his bitterness and feelings of betrayal for his former superior. Taken aback by the criminal's strong feelings, Iroh humbly asked what he could do to earn forgiveness. Keung coldly responded by demanding that Iroh should kill himself.
